meta.name: linkedin-reply-handler
meta.description: Draft a reply to one LinkedIn comment from its URL, or sweep a whole thread from just the post URL and draft a reply to every comment worth answering, in one batch. Use for replying to a comment, following an author reply, or clearing all comments on a post. Resolves the correct parentComment (LinkedIn flattens threads to 2 levels), filters low-value comments before a sweep, and posts via Publora on approval. Not for top-level comments (use linkedin-comment-drafter).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为 LinkedIn 帖子下的评论批量起草回复,确认后直接发布。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你在 LinkedIn 发帖后要逐条回复评论,又想省下手工时间。
copy.tagline_en: Draft replies to every LinkedIn comment on a post, then publish after your approval.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you post on LinkedIn and need to answer many comments without the manual grind.

howto.what: 给它一条 LinkedIn 评论链接，它会读取该帖与评论上下文，起草 1~2 条回复（150–300 字符），附上对被回复评论的反应建议，等你批准后经 Publora 发布。
howto.when: 当你粘贴带 commentUrn 的 LinkedIn 评论链接并要求回复，或作者回复了你的评论、你想继续对话时。不处理顶层评论（那用 linkedin-comment-drafter）。

say.text: 回复这条评论：<粘贴带 commentUrn 的 LinkedIn 链接>
say.note: 解析链接、抓上下文并给出草稿

say.text: 帮我扫一遍这个帖子的评论区，回复值得回的那些
say.note: 批量起草后逐条审批发布

say.text: 作者回复我了，帮我接上这段对话
say.note: 找到顶层评论 URN 后起草回复

howto.what_en: Give it a LinkedIn comment link: it reads the post and thread context, drafts 1-2 replies (150-300 chars), suggests a reaction for the comment you're answering, and posts via Publora once you approve.
howto.when_en: When you paste a LinkedIn comment URL containing commentUrn and ask to reply, or when an author replied and you want to continue the thread. Not for top-level comments (use linkedin-comment-drafter).

say_en.text: Reply to this: <paste the LinkedIn link with commentUrn>
say_en.note: Parses the URL and shows a draft card

say_en.text: Sweep this post's comments and reply to the ones worth answering
say_en.note: Drafts replies for approval one by one

say_en.text: The author replied to me - help me continue the thread
say_en.note: Finds the top-level URN to reply under
